record.label: Typed mean-plus-variance autonomous state CV
record.summary: The verified fourfold full-688 typed-state result is finite at OOF final MSE 3.5165106535091496e-8. It improves the state-independent Duhamel form by 10.01995% but remains 6.65959% worse than P2R0F2D, 18.51065% above its frozen mean gate, and reaches maximum per-network MSE 3.42368130350359e-7 at rank643/mlp364. Diagonal prediction-error variance therefore does not arrest the late-depth accumulation in this exact form; observer_selection remained sealed.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed for this exact H96 typed signed-mean plus diagonal-error-variance six-epoch form because verified OOF mean and maximum-network MSE fail both frozen gates; materially different observable-state successors remain open.
